Burnaby acreages for sale: houses and land on lots of one acre or more. The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® benchmark for a detached house in Burnaby was $1,694,900 in September 2026. Jared sets up a search for the size, area and use you want, and checks whether the land is in the ALR before you offer.
Burnaby houses with acreage sold, November 2025 to October 2026
Fewer than 3 houses with acreage sold in Burnaby, too few to describe.
When so few sell, one sale is the whole picture, so this page does not quote a typical price. Ask Jared for the recent sales near the address you are looking at.

blocks.source: Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS®, MLS® Home Price Index, September 2026 (released October 2, 2026). The benchmark is the board’s modelled price for a typical home of this type, not an average of sales. The index sets January 2005 at 100. Changes are as published; the text below calls a change a rise or fall only at 1.5% or more.

blocks.text: Burnaby East: the detached houses benchmark was $1,694,900 in September 2026. blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: Is Burnaby a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in Burnaby had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many acreages are for sale in Burnaby?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the acreages in Burnaby that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when acreages come up in Burnaby?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all Burnaby homes?
faq.a: The Burnaby homes for sale page covers every home type, and the Burnaby market stats page has the monthly figures.
